gates.name: package-tests
gates.command: timeout 600 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --locked -p dracon-system

gates.name: package-clippy
gates.command: timeout 600 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo clippy --locked -p dracon-system -- -D warnings

gates.name: all-targets-clippy
gates.command: timeout 600 env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo clippy --locked -p dracon-system --all-targets -- -D warnings
